what_each_new_part_touches: Sub-step 1: a dark-grey 1 x 2 beam is clipped to the cylinder's fixed end. Sub-step 2: the 5-long axle is pushed through it.
The cylinder is then lowered between the two posts and the axle slides through the post holes (green arrows).
where_everything_is_after: the air cylinder lies along the left side with its fixed end pinned between the two posts and its rod pointing forward

why.why_these_parts: A cylinder with a pivot axle can swing up and down as air pushes the rod.
why.sets_up_for_later: It will drive the upper body's arm later.

review_note: The cylinder has no catalog points, so joins to it are only shown in DOES lines. The loose grey pin (5th part of the parts box) is used near the rod end; where is not visible here.
